newsitem.title: USA: Clinton frustrated by not knowing TWA 800 cause.
newsitem.headline: Clinton frustrated by not knowing TWA 800 cause.

text.p: President Clinton expressed disappointment and frustration Thursday at not knowing the exact cause of the crash of TWA Flight 800 one year ago.
"Of course I'm disappointed that we don't conclusively know. But I'm not sure what else we can do," Clinton told reporters in the Rose Garden of the White House.
The Boeing 747, bound for Paris from New York's Kennedy Airport, exploded in flames off the Long Island coast in the evening of last July 17, killing all 230 people on board.
Investigators agree the explosion of the plane's center fuel tank was the event that destroyed the plane but what touched off that blast is still under investigation.
"I don't know what else we can do. If anybody has any ideas about what else we can do to try and definitively put this issue behind us I would be happy to explore them," Clinton said.
"But it has been a frustrating experience for me not to know 100 percent what caused that crash."
